steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Sin is any action that goes against God's will. Christians believe that sin separates humans from God and that all people have a tendency to sin (original sin), which stems from Adam and Eve's disobedience in Genesis 3. | Exam Tip: Different Christian traditions emphasise different aspects of salvation. Protestants tend to emphasise grace and faith alone (sola fide), while Catholics emphasise the importance of both faith and good works cooperating with grace. | RS Exam Tips — Sin and Salvation: 1. For Sin and Salvation questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3.
